title: Ouroboros Thesis v10 — EXHAUSTIVE-AUDIT: The Audit Closure Operator Λ₁₀
description: v10 of the Ouroboros thesis chain introduces the Audit Closure Operator Lambda_10, a machine-verifiable meta-invariant over the v1..v7+Omega Lutar family. For each layer L_k we define A_k = L_k * product over six artefact-presence indicators (CODE, CODEX, API, TEST, THESIS, SURFACE), with Lambda_10 = sum_k A_k. Closure theorem: Lambda_10 / sum L_k = 1 iff every artefact is present for every layer. The operator is strictly inert in the all-operational limit and quantifies operational drift exactly otherwise. Shipping artefacts: lutarV10Audit (TypeScript), POST /api/ouroboros/lutar/v10, codex node lutar_v10, and an 8-test contract suite. Companion to szl-holdings/ouroboros-thesis v9.
